qs.q: A medical student is reviewing drug interactions for antihistamines. Which class of drugs is noted to interact with certain first-generation antihistamines via enzyme inhibition?
qs.e: First-generation antihistamines interact with enzyme inhibitors such as macrolides, antifungals, and calcium antagonists. Beta-blockers do not share this specific metabolic drug interaction profile in the context of antihistamines.
